payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates through moves, marks cell, then checks the 4 surrounding 2x2 squares. If all cells in any are black, prints move number; else after all moves prints 0.
payload.rationale: Not a search algorithm; no backtracking, branching, or enumeration. Just simulation with constant-time check. None of the subtypes fit; chosen branch_and_bound as rule suggested, with very low confidence.
